add-label.description: Localizable free-entry offer. {text} is replaced by the trimmed query.

allow-custom.description: Offers to add trimmed query text when no known or selected choice already matches it.

disabled.description: Disables editing, navigation and form submission.

empty-label.description: Localizable status when there are no choices to display.

error-text.description: Message used when a required selection is missing, in place of the browser's message.

filter.description: Filters by label. Set to none when the application provides results from a remote search.

help-text.description: Guidance shown below the field and read as its description.

label.description: Visible label and accessible name. Supply it even when placeholder text is also set.

loading.description: Replaces visible options with a loading indicator while a search is pending.

loading-label.description: Localizable status while waiting for a result set.

multiple.description: Enables ordered multiple selection and renders selected values as tags.

name.description: Form-data key. Multiple choices contribute one entry each under this name.

placeholder.description: Hint shown in the text input when it is empty.

remove-label.description: Localizable removal button label. {label} is replaced by the selected label.

required.description: Requires a committed choice to submit the form.

result-count-label.description: Localizable status for several choices. {count} is replaced by the result count.

result-one-label.description: Localizable status for one available choice.

value.description:
Committed value. Use a string for single selection and an array of strings
for multiple selection. In HTML and catalog specs, encode multiple values
as a JSON array string in the value attribute, or supply one literal value.
Assign a new array to change multiple selections programmatically.

--ki-combobox-field-height.description: Resting minimum block size of the field.

--ki-combobox-icon-size.description: Size of search, selection and remove glyphs.

--ki-combobox-input-basis.description: Preferred text-entry width before a row of tags wraps.

--ki-combobox-input-touch-font-size.description: Minimum editable text size for coarse-pointer input.

--ki-combobox-listbox-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for the floating listbox.

--ki-combobox-listbox-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the floating listbox.

--ki-combobox-listbox-max-block-size.description: Maximum listbox block size before options scroll.

--ki-combobox-match-fg.description: Foreground of the first bolded query match.

--ki-corner-field-item.description: Corner radius for choices and tokens inside an editable field.

--ki-corner-field-surface.description: Corner radius for an editable field and its floating choice surface.

--ki-density-control-offset.description: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xxs.description: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-outline-danger-high-em.description: semantic color for outline danger high em.

--ki-outline-hairline-width.description: Resting hairline for control and floating surface boundaries.

--ki-text-danger-high-em.description: semantic color for text danger high em.

--ki-text-high-em.description: semantic color for text high em.

--ki-text-supporting.description: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

--ki-typography-weight-body-bold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body bold.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description:
An editable, form-associated combobox with local or remote filtering,
single or multiple selection, and optional free entry.

change.description:
Composed event after a user changes the committed selection.
Read the committed value from the host.

ki-input.description: Reports a raw text edit in `detail.value`. Listen to it to request remote results.

error.description: Polite error message shown after failed validation.

field.description: Container for the text input and selected tags.

input.description: Native text input with the combobox role.

label.description: Visible label of the field and its listbox.

remove.description: A native button that removes a selected tag.

tag.description: A selected value in multiple mode.
